# Topology.MoveAPI.verify_search_store

Exports: `Topology.MoveAPI.verify_search_store`, `Topology.verify_search_store`

## `verify_search_store(store::MoveGraphStoreDB) -> NamedTuple`

    verify_search_store(store::MoveGraphStoreDB) -> NamedTuple

Return o-graph search-schema and record counts after checking storage integrity through the common move API.

# Arguments
`store` must be open with readable search tables. As in
[`verify_ograph_search_store`](verify_ograph_search_store.md), missing or unsupported schema metadata
and foreign-key failures throw `ArgumentError`; database and parsing errors
can occur first.

# Returns
The search-store summary: integer `schema_version`, `states`, `runs`,
`expansions`, `operations`, `successful_edges` and `weighted_trials` counts.

# Guarantees
1. The result equals `verify_ograph_search_store(store)` and the database is
   unchanged. Successful return confirms the current version and absence of
   reported foreign-key violations. [proved/agent: by construction]
2. Counts refer to [search records](../../specs/ograph-search-db.md#workflow),
   not distinct spaces or mathematically verified equivalences.
   [proved/agent: by construction]

# Not guaranteed
For this method, verification does not replay transitions, recompute hashes,
check weighted trials or establish neighborhood completeness. The generic
API's broad description does not supply those checks here.

# Sources
cf: lib/topology.jl/docs/specs/ograph-search-db.md §Workflow — record families of the o-graph search store.

# Examples
```jldoctest
julia> store = open_store(); migrate_ograph_search_store!(store); path = joinpath(pkgdir(Topology), "test", "ograph_search_db.jl");

julia> begin_ograph_search_run!(store, path; label="literal-02-smoke"); begin_ograph_search_run!(store, path; label="literal-02-reuse");

julia> Topology.MoveAPI.verify_search_store(store).runs
2

julia> close_store!(store);
```

See also [`verify_ograph_search_store`](verify_ograph_search_store.md), [`replay_weighted_ograph_path`](replay_weighted_ograph_path.md).

## `verify_search_store(store::MoveGraphStoreDB) -> NamedTuple`

    verify_search_store(store::MoveGraphStoreDB) -> NamedTuple

Check o-graph search-schema metadata and foreign keys and count its stored records.

# Arguments
Requires an open store with readable o-graph search tables under M7
([conditions](../../specs/move-graph-store.md#numbered-conditions)). Missing or
unsupported version metadata and foreign-key violations raise `ArgumentError`
identifying the problem. Missing tables, malformed version text and database
failures can raise their parsing or database errors first.

# Returns
Integer fields `schema_version`, `states`, `runs`, `expansions`, `operations`,
`successful_edges` and `weighted_trials`, with the record-family meanings in
the [search specification](../../specs/ograph-search-db.md#workflow).

# Guarantees
1. Results and validation equal `verify_ograph_search_store(store)`. Success means the schema version matches and the foreign-key check found no violations. [proved/agent: by construction]
2. The database is not modified. [proved/agent: by construction]

# Not guaranteed
No move or weighted trial is replayed, identity recomputed, or search
completeness established. There is no HC method at this generic entry point.

# Sources
cf:lib/topology.jl/docs/specs/module-structure.md §3.1 — the currently implemented o-graph verification adapter.

# Examples
```jldoctest
julia> s = open_store(); migrate_ograph_search_store!(s);

julia> path = joinpath(pkgdir(Topology), "test", "ograph_search_db.jl"); begin_ograph_search_run!(s,path; label="literal-02-smoke"); begin_ograph_search_run!(s,path; label="literal-02-reuse");

julia> Topology.MoveAPI.verify_search_store(s).runs
2

julia> close_store!(s);
```
